title: When Safety Checks Become Privacy Risks: A Privacy-Preserving Paradigm for LLM Agent Safety Auditing
abstract: arXiv:2610.41401v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model agents interact with online services through tool calls that may access private data or perform sensitive actions. Specialized providers can supply and maintain pre-execution safety auditing capabilities for agent operators. However, sending task descriptions, call arguments, and interaction histories to an external auditor may expose sensitive user information. In this work, we propose a paradigm for privacy-preserving safety auditing that separates delegated audit computation from plaintext access and execution authority. Grounded in a three-domain auditing model, the paradigm connects trusted representation construction, encrypted audit computation, and trusted decision and execution through explicit interfaces. These interfaces accommodate alternative representations and scorers, while encrypted computation protects audit inputs from a semi-honest auditor. translated_title: 当安全检查成为隐私风险：面向大语言模型智能体安全审计的隐私保护范式
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体通过工具调用与在线服务交互，这些调用可能访问私有数据或执行敏感操作。专业化的服务提供商可以为智能体运营方提供并维护执行前的安全审计能力。然而，将任务描述、调用参数和交互历史发送给外部审计方可能会暴露敏感的用户信息。在本工作中，我们提出了一种隐私保护的安全审计范式，该范式将委托的审计计算与明文访问权限和执行权限相分离。基于三域审计模型，该范式通过显式接口连接可信表示构建、加密审计计算以及可信决策与执行。这些接口支持可替换的表示形式和评分器，同时加密计算保护审计输入免受半诚实审计方的窥探。我们在SealCall框架中实例化了这一范式（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种隐私保护的LLM智能体安全审计范式，通过三域审计模型将委托审计计算与明文访问及执行权限分离，并利用加密计算保护审计输入，防止用户敏感信息在外部审计过程中泄露。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a privacy-preserving paradigm for LLM agent safety auditing that separates delegated audit computation from plaintext access and execution authority, using encrypted computation within a three-domain auditing model to protect sensitive user information from semi-honest auditors.
